scientific_question: Can the replicated L_T direct-fidelity mechanism rescue globally omitted learned relations if local and global computations use different admission rules for the same observed support evidence?
core_hypothesis: The external support pair and signed visible magnitude are observed before the stable subject-encoding bottleneck. Global assembly uses a fixed binary admission z_sr, whereas direct-experience persistence can retain a weaker reliability-weighted trace when z_sr=0. The missing mechanism is differential evidence admission into two already causally distinct computations, not a new address, memory update, gain, query readout, or transitive learner.
claim_boundary: This is a zero-new-parameter, two-frozen-backbone development sufficiency test on previously characterized seeds 2102 and 2103. It can test whether one prospectively defined differential-admission rule explains stable-omitted direct errors. It cannot establish network-population prevalence, biological memory stores, unique tensor-product coding, a full subject evidence model, or formal confirmation on unseen backbones.
registration_timing: Frozen after the complete v2.3 two-backbone replication and before writing v2.4 code, constructing any v2.4 Liu condition, or inspecting any v2.4 omitted-cell outcome.

development_seed_contract.mandatory_execution: Both frozen backbones must be evaluated under every condition. Seed 2102 may not determine whether seed 2103 is evaluated.
development_seed_contract.inference_boundary: Both seeds are development backbones already characterized by v2.3. Decide each link separately within seed and then require both-seed directional replication; do not pool participants or make a network-population inference.

execution_contract.device: visible CUDA GPU required for frozen neural replay
execution_contract.implementation_freeze: Commit and push the v2.4 implementation, tests, and source lock before either seed is evaluated.
execution_contract.artifact_reuse: Only the jointly frozen v2.3 seed-2102 and seed-2103 checkpoint and gain artifacts may be used; all hashes must match before evaluation.
execution_contract.result_write: Evaluate both mandatory seeds in one command and write the result only after both are complete.
execution_contract.seed_subject_relation_orientation_or_tri: forbidden; the frozen stable-omission mask defines retained and omitted groups prospectively

observed_evidence_boundary.external_support: Every registered support trial externally presents the left/right pair cues and a signed visible magnitude m_t=plus_or_minus rank_gap/(n_items-1); no choice or feedback is provided.
observed_evidence_boundary.existing_subject_state: The unchanged SubjectEncodingState gives relation reliability p_sr in [0.1,1) from its fixed baseline, item salience, and distance sensitivity. This state and p_sr already generate the frozen global admission and add no v2.4 parameter or Liu fit.
observed_evidence_boundary.global_admission: The existing stable-omission draw z_sr~Bernoulli(p_sr) is fixed once per subject-relation and reused across all four support blocks.
observed_evidence_boundary.not_unobserved_information: v2.4 may route only the signed magnitude of an actually presented support trial. It may not write an unpresented pair, true query label, correctness, posterior relation, LOO target, human response, or inferred relation.

frozen_mechanism.state_update: L_(t+1)=L_t+s_t^L k_t exactly once at support step 0, with rho=1 and omega=1
frozen_mechanism.policy: m_e=m_G,e+lambda_L ell_e with the unchanged symmetric plus/minus half-margin correction
frozen_mechanism.gain: Use the exact frozen generic-only v2.3 lambda_L for each backbone: no refit, rescaling, or condition-specific gain.
frozen_mechanism.global_path: P_T, all recurrent support dynamics, query dynamics, activation, output readout, and global effective evidence remain exactly v1/v2.3.
frozen_mechanism.only_changed_variable: The local support-write evidence scalar s_t^L.

evidence_admission_equations.retained_identity: If z_sr=1, s_t^(L,dual)=m_t=s_t^(L,shared), so every retained relation's own local write is exactly unchanged.
evidence_admission_equations.omitted_weak_access: If z_sr=0, s_t^(L,dual)=m_t p_sr while s_t^(L,shared)=0. The continuous p_sr retains the existing subject-specific evidence strength rather than granting full-strength raw evidence.
evidence_admission_equations.capacity: The transform is fixed, shared, monotone, and has zero trainable or calibrated parameters.

control_contract.local_off_v1: Use the frozen P_T global channel with zero local correction; this must exactly restore v1.
control_contract.shared_access_v2_3: Use the frozen v2.3 local evidence s_t^L=s_t^G and exact frozen seed-specific gain.
control_contract.dual_access_matched: Use the registered dual-access evidence on the natural support address and the natural query address.
control_contract.dual_access_evidence_shuffle: Within each subject and support block, apply a fixed derangement of the eight signed candidate local evidence scalars across the eight presented cue addresses. Preserve the exact blockwise scalar multiset, global P_T, trial times, write count, local gain, and cue-address multiset while breaking evidence-to-support binding.
control_contract.dual_access_query_shuffle: Use the natural dual-access trace but the frozen v2.3 within-subject canonical query-address derangement, preserving the query-address multiset while breaking trace-to-query matching.
control_contract.global_P_off_dual_access: Replace P_T by zero only during query replay while retaining the natural dual-access L_T.
control_contract.LOO_semantics: For a relation-LOO replay, remove that external support relation from P_T and set its local evidence scalar to zero before any evidence routing. Reuse the exact intact evidence and query maps, so shuffled LOO follows the removed source evidence wherever it was routed rather than deleting a post-shuffle recipient address.

estimand_contract.cell_unit: Subject by learned relation by query orientation; compute correct-signed margins and exact sigmoid probabilities at T=0.25 separately by orientation before averaging.
estimand_contract.omitted_exact_rescue: Within each participant average p_dualaccess-p_shared over stable-omitted learned cells.
estimand_contract.omitted_direct_causal_rescue: For each stable-omitted support relation, subtract relation-LOO total margins from intact total margins, antisymmetrize over query orientations, apply the complete-graph Hodge residual projector, sign the source relation's direct edge by correctness, and average omitted relations within participant.
estimand_contract.retained_preservation: Within each participant average p_dualaccess-p_shared over retained learned cells; also report retained direct-correctness change and exact own-write identity.
estimand_contract.evidence_specificity: Pair dual-access matched against the evidence-shuffled control for omitted exact probability and omitted direct causal correctness.
estimand_contract.query_specificity: Pair dual-access matched against the query-shuffled control for omitted direct causal correctness.
estimand_contract.local_only_partition: Under P-off, report exact probability and sampled hard accuracy separately for retained, omitted, and nonlearned pairs, plus candidate-minus-shared local-only omitted exact probability.
estimand_contract.remote_reassembly: For each omitted or retained source relation, average absolute intact-minus-LOO total-margin influence over disjoint query pairs before within-participant averaging.
estimand_contract.mandatory_secondary_behavior: For every condition report learned, nonlearned, and overall sampled accuracy, coherent-error summaries, symbolic-distance slope, and exact-probability slope decomposition. None is a primary v2.4 gate unless explicitly named below.
estimand_contract.global_mechanism: Report exact P_T identity across local conditions, v1 qualification, fast-weight necessity, query binding, remote/third-party reassembly, and expected-rank-over-MAP projection.

competence_and_integrity_gates.source_and_artifact_hashes: Every registered source, v2.4 implementation source, checkpoint, gain, and reused v2.3 artifact lock must match SHA-256.
competence_and_integrity_gates.backbone: For each seed, local-off/v1 must pass qualification_v2 before v2.4 is interpreted.
competence_and_integrity_gates.shared_access_identity: Shared-access logits, local states, exact probabilities, raw participant/relation causal estimands, and sampled behavior must reproduce the corresponding frozen v2.3 values within their registered numerical tolerances. Bootstrap intervals may differ only because v2.4 uses prospectively new bootstrap-count seeds.
competence_and_integrity_gates.global_identity: P_T and all global logits before local correction must be exactly identical across every local-access and local-control condition.
competence_and_integrity_gates.retained_own_write_identity: For z_sr=1, dual-access and shared-access own local writes must agree within 1e-7.
competence_and_integrity_gates.omitted_source_identity: For z_sr=0, the candidate local scalar must equal m_t p_sr within 1e-7 and use the p_sr that generated the frozen z_sr; no replacement probability or RNG is allowed.
competence_and_integrity_gates.presentation_invariance: Reversing one support presentation must leave s_t^L k_t unchanged within 1e-7, and reversing a query must negate ell_e within 1e-7.
competence_and_integrity_gates.evidence_shuffle_integrity: Every block map is a derangement and preserves the exact signed candidate scalar multiset; intact and every LOO replay reuse the same map.
competence_and_integrity_gates.query_shuffle_integrity: Every map is a canonical address derangement preserving the full query-address multiset; intact and every LOO replay reuse the same map.
competence_and_integrity_gates.parameter_integrity: No parameter changes; every condition within seed uses the same frozen backbone and lambda_L.

primary_links.omitted_direct_fidelity_rescue: Within each seed, both the participant-bootstrap lower bound for omitted dual-access-minus-shared exact probability and the lower bound for omitted dual-access-minus-shared direct causal correctness exceed zero.
primary_links.retained_fidelity_preservation: Within each seed, the participant-bootstrap lower bound for retained dual-access-minus-shared exact probability is at least -0.005, and retained own-write identity passes within 1e-7. The -0.005 noninferiority margin is frozen below the seed-2101 retained rescue magnitude and before any v2.4 result.
primary_links.evidence_and_query_specificity: Within each seed, dual-access matched beats evidence shuffle on both omitted exact probability and omitted direct causal correctness, and beats query shuffle on omitted direct causal correctness; all three paired participant-bootstrap lower bounds must exceed zero.
primary_links.local_only_nontransitive_access: Within each seed under P-off, omitted exact probability has a participant-bootstrap lower bound above 0.50, candidate-minus-shared omitted exact probability has a paired lower bound above zero, sampled nonlearned accuracy has an upper bound at most 0.55, the all-source P-off remote-minus-0.25-times-shared-access all-source remote contrast has an upper bound below zero, and local-off preserves every global competence gate.

cross_seed_decision.link_replication: A link passes the development pilot only if its full within-seed rule passes independently in both 2102 and 2103.
cross_seed_decision.heterogeneous_or_unresolved: If a link passes in only one seed, label it heterogeneous_or_unresolved; do not pool participant rows, average it into a pass, replace a seed, or modify the candidate.
cross_seed_decision.all_links_pass: Differential evidence admission is sufficient on both frozen development backbones. Preserve v2.3 and v2.4, then freeze an independent-backbone confirmation contract before making a population claim.
cross_seed_decision.valid_omitted_rescue_without_specificity: Reject the differential-routing interpretation: extra local evidence energy helps but correct evidence-to-relation or trace-to-query binding is not identified.
cross_seed_decision.valid_rescue_with_retained_harm: Reject this admission rule as a working model even if omitted cells improve; broader access is trading away the already replicated retained channel.
cross_seed_decision.valid_local_only_globalization: Reject the rule if P-off recovers nonlearned/remote inference; L_T is acting as a second global learner rather than direct-experience persistence.
cross_seed_decision.valid_failure: If omitted rescue fails in both seeds under intact competence, reject the simple lower-local-threshold account and revisit the subject-specific evidence model rather than changing L_T address, gain, or query mechanism.
cross_seed_decision.competence_or_integrity_failure: The affected seed is non-interpretable. Repair execution under the same frozen contract without changing equations, maps, seeds, margins, or outcome rules.
